name: Sonic Forces Untold: Darkest of Days
source:
Sonic is gone, and his absence casts the world into darkness. Through multiple routes, experience his friends’ battles with sorrow, danger, and their hidden feelings, as they search for closure, love, and the chance to bring him back.

[From [url=https://yugoalley.itch.io/sonic-forces-untold-darkest-of-days]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
索尼克走了，他的缺席让世界陷入了黑暗。通过多条路线，体验他的朋友们与悲伤、危险和隐藏的情感的斗争，寻找结束、爱和把他带回来的机会。

[来自[url=https://yugoalley.itch.io/sonic-forces-untold-darkest-of-days]Itch.io[/url]]
